glossary: Trigger / 觸發條件
The occurrence that makes work eligible: a deadline, incoming event or completed task.
讓工作具備執行條件的事情，例如到期、事件到來或前項工作完成。
Payload / 工作資料
The data attached to a trigger, such as an instruction, event text or script. It tells the receiver what to process.
觸發時附帶的指令、事件內容或 script；它不是 timer。
Fire / 一次觸發紀錄
One occurrence of an automation. A consumer is the code that receives and handles that occurrence.
某個自動化被觸發的一次紀錄；consumer 就是接收並處理紀錄的程式。
Polling / 定期查詢
Repeatedly ask whether new work exists. The checked work may originate from time or events.
定期問有沒有新工作；被查到的工作本身可能來自時間或事件。
Webhook / HTTP 事件通知
Another service sends an HTTP request when something happens. The receiver may filter it before starting an agent.
外部服務主動送 HTTP 通知；接收端可先過濾，再決定是否啟動 agent。
Admission / 執行准入
Runtime checks whether a run may start now, including capacity, busy state and target-session rules.
Runtime 根據容量、忙碌狀態與目標對話規則，判斷現在能否開始。
Lease / 有期限的工作租約
A temporary claim on queued work. Renewing it keeps ownership; it does not create another reasoning turn.
暫時取得某筆工作的執行權；續租維持權利，不會自動新增思考回合。
Revival / 接續等待中的對話
Resume a conversation after a result or event becomes available.
結果或事件到來後，喚回等待中的對話繼續處理。
Cadence / 執行節奏
How often a recurring check runs. Adaptive pacing changes the next due time.
週期檢查多久執行一次；自適應節奏會調整下一次時間。
Goal continuation / 目標續跑
After a turn, decide whether the assigned goal needs another turn within its limits.
回合結束後，判斷交付目標是否仍需要在限制內繼續。
